name_reason: Name is convention-compliant and accurate: data_fd2_ prefix, dialog domain, descriptor reflects both purpose (blit offset for the active portrait) and that it is a scalar offset cell. No Ghidra address residue in the suffix (the only hex in the name is the well-formed descriptor, not an address). Confirmed against binary: readers ADD this dword to a framebuffer base and CMP it against slot constants; writers MOV slot immediates/registers into it.
purpose: Active dialog/portrait blit offset: a mode-13h (320x200) linear pixel offset added to a framebuffer base (0xA0000 VRAM or a 64000-byte composed-overlay workspace) to position the current portrait / dialog panel, and doubling as the active-dialog-mode selector that readers branch on.
logic_summary: Single 4-byte runtime cell. Writers set it per scene to one of a small set of slot offsets: 0x728 (in-field NPC dialog), 0x9017 (status/wide slot; also the sentinel value that makes the portrait blitter use a horizontally-mirrored blit and that fd2_play_dialog_open_animation maps to vertical origin 0x70), 0xC88 (status-screen portrait slot, used by fd2_render_status_screen_static_layout and fd2_play_final_chapter_30_ending), and 0x10BB/0x6AB/0xF63/0x576/0xE3C (five chapter-intro special portrait positions for portrait_kind 0x80..0x84 in fd2_load_chapter_portrait; default 0x9017). The dialog-close path resets it to 0 (the 'no active dialog' sentinel). Readers either ADD it to a base address to compute a blit destination, or CMP it against 0x728 / 0x9017 to select a rendering path / origin.
datatype: uint32 (undefined4); accessed exclusively as dword ptr
element_semantics: Scalar. Value = mode-13h linear pixel byte-offset into a 320-wide framebuffer for the active portrait/dialog blit; specific values also act as discriminators (0x728 left/NPC slot, 0x9017 right ally slot/mirror sentinel, 0xC88 status portrait slot, 0 = no active dialog). Max observed 0x9017 (36887) exceeds signed 16-bit, confirming a >=32-bit unsigned cell.
